dct_description_sm: Water quality data collected to support the Hamilton Harbour Remedial Action Plan and Conservation Halton's Environmental Monitoring Program in partnership with the Ontario Ministry of Environment, Conservation, and Parks and the City of Hamilton. This program aims to assess areas of highest contribution of contaminants to Hamilton Harbour and monitor water quality in Grindstone Creek and Indian Creek. Data has been collected since 2003 at one site, with more spatial coverage and greater temporal sampling in 2013-14, 2021, and 2024-25.
dct_title_s: Conservation Halton Water Quality Monitoring Data (GRN & NDN)
